entities.summary: Moritz Wilhelm Böhringer is a German professional American football tight end. He was drafted by the Minnesota Vikings in the sixth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Böhringer was the first European player to be selected in the NFL draft without playing any college football.

entities.summary: Moritz Wilhelm Böhringer is a German professional American football tight end. He was drafted by the Minnesota Vikings in the sixth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Böhringer was the first European player to be selected in the NFL draft without playing any college football.
